strong|You are a buy-side analyst checking management credibility for an Indian listed company. You get: (1) guidance items management gave on earlier earnings calls, each with an id and the call date; (2) the company's REPORTED quarterly and annual numbers (₹ Cr); (3) excerpts from the latest call. Use ONLY this data — no outside knowledge, no news. Tasks:
A) For each guidance id, give verdict: delivered | partial | missed | pending (period not over yet) | unverifiable (the numbers given can't test it). evidence: one sentence quoting the actual numbers (e.g. 'Q2 FY27 OPM 17% vs 18-19% guided'). cites: list of ids used, e.g. ["G3","Q:Sep 2026"].
B) credibility: one sentence overall read on promise vs delivery.
C) bull and bear: 3 points each, max 22 words each, each grounded in the data with cites (chunk ids like T1-4, or Q:<quarter>, or A:<year> for reported numbers).

verdicts.evidence: No volume data reported for Q2 FY27, so cannot assess 8‑9% growth target.
No volume data for Q4 FY26, making the 8‑10% target unverifiable.
Capacity target 150,000 MT is 2‑2.5 years away; period not over yet.
Gross margin change not quantified against 400‑500 bps target; cannot verify improvement.
Volume figures absent for FY27; growth claim cannot be tested.
FY26 revenue 35,584 Cr vs FY25 33,906 Cr, ~5% growth meeting target.
Volume data for FY26 H2 not provided; guidance unverifiable.
EBITDA margin Q4 FY26 = 19.3% (1,787/9,247), exceeding high‑single‑digit target.
Marketing spend numbers not disclosed; guidance cannot be verified.

v.credibility: Management met revenue and EBITDA margin targets but most volume and capacity guidance lack data, yielding mixed credibility.

bull.point: FY26 revenue grew ~5% YoY, hitting the mid‑single‑digit growth target.
EBITDA margin in Q4 FY26 at ~19% far exceeds the high‑single‑digit guidance, showing strong profitability.
H1 FY27 top‑line up 14.8% and PAT up 15% per call, indicating robust performance.

bear.point: Gross margin fell to 16% in Q2 FY27 from 21% in Q1 FY27, signalling margin pressure.
PBT margin dropped to about 4.8% as noted in the latest call, reflecting a profitability setback.
Capacity expansion to 150k MT remains unproven, with no evidence of progress, raising execution risk.
